method: Ranked form, lineup, dated simulation and external preview research. Weak or redundant markets remain unfilled.
calibration: Ratings describe editorial evidence strength and are not calibrated chances.

picks.label: Over 2.5 Goals
picks.reason: Eight of Galatasaray’s last ten matches reached three goals, including their 4–2 win at Lille. Stuttgart bring a stronger European defence, but their 4–2 win at Leverkusen shows they can raise the tempo away.

picks.label: Galatasaray or Draw
picks.reason: Galatasaray arrive on four straight wins and have the home edge. Stuttgart took seven points from their first three European games, so a draw is a real possibility.

picks.label: VfB Stuttgart 1+ Goal
picks.reason: Stuttgart scored in four of their last five games. Galatasaray conceded nine times in their first three Champions League matches, giving the visitors a route to a goal.
